column1: # mode_thresholds.tsv - per-mode CTC forward thresholds for the cast-mode routing (issue #30 D3).
# Consumers: wizardreal match.ResourceModeThresholdProvider (PerModeThresholdProvider, issue #29 P6 seam).
# Format (exactly three columns, tab-separated): <mode> <spell> <threshold>.
#   mode     = CastMode name (OPEN / CHANT_CONFIRM / PRACTICE_CONFIRM / GRAY_NARROW), case-insensitive.
#   spell    = spell id for a per-spell row, or * for the mode-wide default row.
#   threshold= the CTC forward-tier acceptance threshold for that mode/spell (the voicecast
#              [match] forwardThreshold calibration scale, default 0.10). Rows may be added/edited
#              without touching code; unknown (mode, spell) pairs fall back to the mode row, then to
#              the voicecast calibration default. The provider ships the row as a ThresholdHint.
# Tier scope: only the forward (CTC posterior) tier is table-driven. The phoneme tier
#   (0.6) and text tier (0.65) keep their voicecast calibration defaults until
#   their own per-mode recalibration lands — S9 validated the 0.65 text threshold unchanged
#   across all four candidate sets (s9_sherpa_report.md), and the S7b recalibration protocol
#   (same-protocol negatives, 1% quantile + 0.03) governs future rows.
# First batch (S9/S6FINAL adopted working point, D-20260919-01 M1 gate): every mode at the
#   shipped 0.10 constant - the working point S9 validated across all four candidate sets.
#   Per-spell and per-mode deviations land here as calibration data (never hard-coded).
OPEN
CHANT_CONFIRM
PRACTICE_CONFIRM
GRAY_NARROW
